map.ND 滤镜快门换算工具按滤镜档数（如 ND1000 约 10 档）求加滤镜后的延: The ND filter shutter conversion tool computes the extended shutter time after adding a filter from its stop count (e.g. ND1000 is about 10 stops), suited to slow-shutter photography that turns flowing water and clouds into a silky texture.
map.由 ND 档数算新快门与延长倍数。: Compute the new shutter speed and extension factor from ND stops.
map.流水/云雾化长曝。: Long exposures that turn flowing water and clouds into mist.
map.：原快门 1/100s、ND1000（10 档）：新快门 = 1/100×2^1: : original shutter 1/100s with ND1000 (10 stops): new shutter = 1/100 x 2^10 = 10.24s, extended 1024 times, turning running water into silky mist.
map.：想 2s 曝光、原 1/500s：需延长 1000 倍≈2^10（ND1000: : wanting a 2s exposure from an original 1/500s: extend by about 1000x, roughly 2^10 (ND1000); if only to blur moving crowds, ND8 (3 stops) is enough.
map.ND 档数怎么算延长？: How do ND stops give the extension factor?
map.每档减一档曝光、快门×2；NDx 档数 n=log2(x)，延长 2^n 倍，N: Each stop cuts exposure by one stop and doubles the shutter time; for NDx the stop count is n = log2(x), extending time by 2^n, so ND1000 = 10 stops x 1024.
map.只减光不改变光圈景深与焦距；为保景深常收小光圈配合 ND 实现长曝。: It only cuts light and does not change aperture, depth of field or focal length; to keep depth of field, stop down and pair it with an ND filter for a long exposure.
